name: pr-deck
description: Pane listing your open PRs across repos, grouped into stacks, with next-action buttons

startCollapsed.title: Start collapsed
startCollapsed.description: PR cards open folded to their title line. Click the arrow to unfold one.

alwaysShowAll.title: Always show all projects
alwaysShowAll.description: Start with PRs from every repo instead of only the current folder's repo.

cardColors.title: Card colors
cardColors.description: attention: cards that need you are bright with a coloured bar, the rest are dimmed. status: border follows the PR state. repo: one colour per repo. random: one colour per PR.

pinYourMove.title: Pin "Your move" on top
pinYourMove.description: PRs waiting on you are listed in a group above the repos.

buttonStyle.title: Button labels
buttonStyle.description: Show icons, text or both on buttons. The next-action button always keeps its text.

defaultGroup.title: Default grouping
defaultGroup.description: How PRs inside a repo are grouped when the pane opens.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane fetches PRs.

showSummary.title: Show summary
showSummary.description: A one-line summary from the PR body under each title.

summaryLength.title: Summary length
summaryLength.description: Most characters the summary line shows before it is cut with an ellipsis. The pane also cuts it at its own width.

showFableButton.title: Show Fable review button
showFableButton.description: A button that asks the session to run a review subagent and report back.

showCopilotPass.title: Offer Copilot pass
showCopilotPass.description: GitHub only. When a PR is green and idle, the work button requests a Copilot review and works its comments.

providers.title: Code hosts
providers.description: Comma-separated list of hosts to fetch PRs from: github, gitlab, gitea, azdo.

tracker.title: Issue tracker
tracker.description: Where ticket keys found in PR titles and branches link to.

trackerUrl.title: Issue tracker URL
trackerUrl.description: Base URL the ticket key is appended to, e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net/browse/ or https://linear.app/yourteam/issue/. Empty shows the key as text.

githubCommand.title: GitHub fetch command
githubCommand.description: Shell command that prints the GitHub GraphQL response. Empty uses the built-in gh api graphql call; {query} is the query.

gitlabCommand.title: GitLab fetch command
gitlabCommand.description: Shell command that prints the GitLab GraphQL response. Empty uses the built-in glab api graphql call; {query} is the query.

giteaCommand.title: Gitea/Forgejo fetch command
giteaCommand.description: Shell command that prints the Gitea JSON response. Empty uses the built-in tea api call.

azdoCommand.title: Azure DevOps fetch command
azdoCommand.description: Shell command that prints the Azure DevOps PR list JSON. Empty uses the built-in az repos pr list call.

openCommand.title: Open URL command
openCommand.description: Opens links in the browser; {url} is the link.

editorCommand.title: Open config file command
editorCommand.description: Opens the config file; {path} is its path.

remoteCommand.title: Current repo command
remoteCommand.description: Prints the remote URL of the session's repo, used to scope the pane.

cloneDir.title: Local clone folder
cloneDir.description: Where a repo's clone lives, used by the new session button. {host}, {owner} and {repo} are filled in, e.g. ~/code/{host}/{owner}/{repo}. Empty starts in the current folder.

newSessionCommand.title: New session command
newSessionCommand.description: Opens a new Claude session for a PR. {claude} is claude with the session name flag, {dir} the clone folder, {prompt} the first prompt and {label} the PR name. Empty (the default) picks automatically: a herdr, tmux, zellij, WezTerm or kitty tab, else Ghostty, iTerm or Terminal.

autoRename.title: Auto rename sessions
autoRename.description: Name the session that New session opens or Switch here moves, using Session name.

sessionName.title: Session name
sessionName.description: Name given to the session that New session opens or Switch here moves. {number} is the PR number and {repo} the repo name. Empty leaves sessions unnamed.
